data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental with no license in 2029? You're in the right place. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or a full-day island hop, our fleet of 17 boats — from 6.4m speedboats to 29m superyachts — all include a licensed skipper. That means zero paperwork, zero exams, just pure Mediterranean fun. Here's what you'll pay for a Marbella boat rental no license prices 2029.

Why No License Rentals Work in Marbella

Spanish law requires a PATENTE de Navegación for any boat over 6m without a skipper. But every boat in our fleet comes with a professional captain. So you never need a license. You just show up, step aboard, and the skipper handles navigation, mooring, and safety. Perfect for tourists, groups, and first-timers.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2029: Tier A

Our most affordable no-license options are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

For 2029, expect a 3–5% price increase. So an 8-hour charter might be around €2,370–€2,414. Still excellent value for a private boat in Puerto Banús.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2029: Tier B

If you want more space and a free jet ski, go for the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or the identical grey variant. Minimum 4 hours at €4,719. That includes a jet ski towed behind — no extra cost. Perfect for groups wanting to combine cruising with water sports.

Other Boats — Pricing on Request

For larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 (29m), Canados 86 (26m), Maiora 26m, or K80 (24m), pricing is custom. Contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. All include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. No license needed.

What's Included in Every No-License Charter

Every booking — no matter the boat — includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no surprises

You can also add catering, extra drinks, or water toys. Just ask.

Where You Can Go Without a License

Our skippers know the Costa del Sol inside out. Popular routes from Puerto Banús include:

  • Marbella Marina & Golden Mile — 15 min cruise
  • Cala del Faro & Cala Cortés — 30 min, great for swimming
  • Cabopino — 45 min, quieter coves
  • Estepona — 1 hour, charming old town from the sea
  • Sotogrande — 1.5 hours, luxury marina

Your skipper will tailor the itinerary to your group's wishes. No license required.

How to Book for 2029

Ready to secure your Marbella boat rental no license prices 2029? Browse our full fleet and contact us via WhatsApp. We'll confirm availability, send a quote, and you're set. No deposit needed for Tier A boats — just pay on the day.
